content: WebSocket reconnect pitfall generalized across exchanges: naive reconnect handlers resume from a cached snapshot/last-known-state WITHOUT checking a sequence-id gap, silently drifting local order-book/position state after any disconnect - the correct pattern is to check the first post-reconnect sequence id against last-stored id+1, and on any gap, discard local state and re-snapshot via REST rather than trusting the stream to self-heal. RESEARCH.md mentions 'REST reconciliation after reconnect' but does not spell out the sequence-gap-detection mechanism this requires.
